|skos:definition
            
        
            
            
|A subdivision of a Planned Procurement that may later become one or more Lots or a self-standing Procedure. A Lot or a Procedure can also cover one or more parts of the Planned Procurement.
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        

        
        
            
            
|ns1:ProcedureSpecificTerm
            
        
            
            
|Procedure specific term
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        
            
            
|skos:definition
            
        
            
            
|Gathering class for conditions and stipulations related to a Procedure.
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        

        
        
            
            
|ns1:ProcurementCriterion
            
        
            
            
|Procurement criterion
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        
            
            
|skos:definition
            
        
            
            
|A criterion specific to Procurement. Additional Information: This Procurement Criterion can be only Exclusion Ground, Selection Criterion or Award Criterion. Each of these Criteria can contain subcriteria (Criterion class).
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        

        
        
            
            
|ns1:RequestForClarification
            
        
            
            
|Request for clarification
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        
            
            
|skos:definition
            
        
            
            
|A demand for elucidation of received information. Additional Information: Requests for clarification are usually used by Buyers during the process of award or evaluation to understand specific aspects of the Tender without altering the Tender.
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        

        
        
            
            
|ns1:RequestForParticipation
            
        
            
            
|Request for participation
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        
            
            
|skos:definition
            
        
            
            
|Application of an Economic Operator to be included in a Procurement Procedure.
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        

        
        
            
            
|ns1:ReviewObject
            
        
            
            
|Review object
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        
            
            
|skos:definition
            
        
            
            
|Information about a Review Request or a Review Decision.
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        

        
        
            
            
|ns1:SpecificDuration
            
        
            
            
|Specific duration
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        
            
            
|skos:definition
            
        
            
            
|The exact Duration.
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        

        
        
            
            
|ns1:VehicleInformation
            
        
            
            
|Vehicle information
            
        
            
            
|en
            
        
            
            
|skos:definition
            
        
            
            
|Information related to clean vehicles legislation. Additional information: In the European Union, the legislation concerned is the European Parliament and Council 2009/33/EC (Clean Vehicles Directive – CVD).
            
        
            
            
|en
